name: Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Credit Card

localized_names.en: Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Credit Card

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the U.S.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 point for each dollar spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: Southwest Airlines purchases (flights, inflight, Southwest gift cards, and Getaways packages)
Grocery stores and dining at restaurants (first $8,000 combined each account anniversary year, then 1x)

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed for Southwest flights and other rewards through the Rapid Rewards program. Your points don't expire, a benefit of the Rapid Rewards program.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 55,000 bonus points after you spend $1,500 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.

benefits.title: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First checked bag free for Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation can check their bag at no additional cost. Save up to $90 round trip ($45 per bag per trip).

benefits.title: Complimentary Preferred Seat
benefits.description: Select a Preferred seat within 48 hours prior to departure, when available.

benefits.title: 6,000 Anniversary Points
benefits.description: 6,000 points every year on your Cardmember anniversary.

benefits.title: 15% Flight Discount
benefits.description: Receive a 15% promo code each year on your Cardmember anniversary (Excludes Basic fare).

benefits.title: Spend Your Way to A-List
benefits.description: Earn 1,500 tier qualifying points (TQPs) toward A-List status for every $5,000 spent in purchases annually accelerating your way to A-List status.

benefits.title: 10,000 Companion Pass Qualifying Points Boost
benefits.description: 10,000 Companion Pass® qualifying points boost each year.

benefits.title: Boarding Benefit
benefits.description: Cardmembers and up to 8 additional passengers in the same reservation will board with Group 5 giving them earlier access to overhead bins.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the time period of the manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from the date of purchase.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Complimentary DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass, membership for both DoorDash and Caviar, that provides unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders. Activate by Dec 31, 2027. Plus, DashPass members get up to $10 off quarterly on non-restaurant DoorDash orders through Dec 31, 2027.
